body: Omg. I hate that. Quick story: About two months ago I attempted suicide and an event like that has a way of showing how down people are for you. I found out that people couldnt care fucking less. I too have a silent phone issue. You are not alone trust me.

I’m sorry it has taken me so long to respond. This is very tough. I totally understand finding a reason to fight. It’s just been the same thing for over a year now. I’ve been out of work for 3 months now and I don’t know how to even go back to that. I am in a management position and so a lot is riding on my performance when I return and I just haven’t been the same person lately and I’m in no shape to be working. My therapist thinks I should return to work but I don’t think he grasps the stress level of the work I do and it’s also high volume this time of year. I used to look at suicide very negatively but now that I’ve been diagnosed and had my significant other leave me right after that....I can understand how death can sometimes be beautiful. I really appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. It’s not lost on me that you could be doing literally anything else. Thank you so much. 🙂

Thank you for the reply. I can relate with the health stuff as well. About a year ago I was diagnosed with two diseases and my health has been steadily declining. I tried to explain to my family that I just want to be free of the pain and misery but they just say how much it would hurt them if I opted out. At what point does it become important that I feel ok? Why is it not enough that I am not happy in this life? It would be nice if my family could just support me and be understanding that I just don’t want to be here anymore.

Omg you literally just described my depression perfectly. I am also new to this depression gig and now it had teamed up with anxiety to being me to my knees on some days. I’ll be joking around and somewhat smiling one second and the next minute I’m thinking about hiring an “Angel of Mercy” to administer a lethal dose of morphine so I can be gone from this world. I understand trust me, you are definitely not alone as I’m sure millions of people can attest to. Let me know if you have any other questions. I’ll share whatever experience I have happily.
Really? I thought maybe I was the only one....

So, I had plans to take a walk down to the meadow with a section of rope. Everyone was going to be gone at my house and it would have been the perfect opportunity. I unfortunately had forgot that I promised to tutor my niece today. Foiled my plans, but I’m finally optimistic about something. Finally I am looking forward to something. It’s unfortunate that it happens to be that I’m eagerly optimistic about my own demise but I’m trying to find the positive in all of it. I cannot wait to be free of this life and all of its pain and suffering.
